$comment: Condition table for the fleet supervisor. Evaluated every tick against zero-token signals (PTY tail, status, quiet time, git state). Override per-machine with ~/.agent-workspace/supervisor-rules.json.
$comment_autonomy: off = nothing runs. observe = findings recorded, no side effects (start here). assist = may notify and nudge. autopilot = may also run built-in act handlers.

safety.$comment: Act handlers are named functions in server/supervisor/supervisorActions.js. Rules cannot inject shell commands — they can only select a handler from this list.
safety.$comment_permission: An auto-answered permission prompt must match one of these AND none of the deny patterns. Anything else escalates to you.

conditions.label: Waiting on a permission prompt

tailMatches: Do you want to (proceed|make this edit|create)

conditions.advice: The agent has been sitting on a permission prompt. Answer it or let autopilot approve read-only prompts.

conditions.label: Usage limit reached
conditions.advice: This session is blocked until the window resets. Nothing to do but wait — resume it after the reset time in the banner.

conditions.label: Repeating the same error
conditions.advice: The same error line keeps coming back — the agent is looping. This one needs a human, never automation.

conditions.label: Busy but silent
conditions.nudgeText: status? if you are blocked, say what on and stop.

tailNotMatches: Do you want to (proceed|make this edit)

conditions.advice: Marked busy but nothing has come out for 15 minutes.

conditions.label: Agent exited, shell left behind
conditions.advice: The agent CLI is gone and the terminal dropped back to a shell. Relaunch it or reuse the worktree.

conditions.label: Finished with unpushed commits
conditions.nudgeText: You have local commits that are not pushed. Push the branch and open a PR.
conditions.advice: Work is done on disk but has not left the machine.

conditions.label: Idle with uncommitted changes
conditions.nudgeText: You have uncommitted changes. Commit them with a descriptive message, or say why they should not be committed.
conditions.advice: Edits are sitting in the working tree with nothing recorded.

conditions.label: Idle worktree, nothing in flight
conditions.advice: Free capacity — this worktree could take the next queue item.
